This composition looks like a maraging steel, specifically a C-250/C-300/C-350 or a Co-rich grade. It has Ni 18, Co 13, Mo 3.6 and Ti 1.88, which is higher in Ti than the usual grades. That points to a high-strength grade of about 2000 MPa or more. I did not look this row up in the dataset. The figure is my estimate from the grade, not a recorded value.
